dedupe_keys.name: electric grid disturbance dataset from european system separation 2021

description: Electric Grid Disturbance Dataset from European System Separation (2021) is a data set deposited in INESC TEC by its authors Fábio Matheus Mantelli. On 8 January 2021 at 14:05 CET the synchronous area of Continental Europe was separated into two separated areas due to outages of several transmission network elements in a very short time. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. Formats: XML. Size stated: 7.15; 21.2MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
